## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Manage fish populations and habitats to stated conservation and harvest objectives — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Conduct fisheries stock assessments and develop management advice — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Capture, handle and mark wildlife and fish humanely and safely — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Operate small boats and work safely on water in aquatic, coastal and marine field settings — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Apply field biosecurity and decontamination protocols — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2, lead L2
- Operate fish hatchery and aquatic propagation programmes — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
